assumptions.statement: Real fabrication and instrument contact sequences are qualified closed services. This is an authored integration boundary, not a robot interface reported by the authors.
Retained carriers, custody docks and post-use cleanup are authored design needs with no invented scene geometry.
Synthetic tests may use small named schedules solely to exercise contracts; these do not reconstruct source images or resolve missing source schedules.
Release is an environment observation bound to the current cycle. An actor assertion or commanded retraction is not evidence of physical release.
A qualified prefabricated object allows bounded metrology design only, and cannot make source fabrication complete.
Eight experimental branches are counted once each. Operations, control cycles and numerical obligations are not additional papers.
